They've had 14 inches of snow at @MammothMountain since I left on Saturday. More snow expected Tuesday and Thursday. This is a classic La Nina season. Snow at the start and end, but not in the middle. #ClimateCrisis threatens to make this our norm.
At the @latimesfob again. Waiting for the first of two #ClimateCrisis panels to begin.

Books purchased at @latimesfob:
- L.A. Weather, by Maria Amparo Escandon
- Appleseed, by Matt Bell
- running out: in search of water on the high plains, by Lucas Bessire
- The Memory Librarian, by Janelle Monae

First three are #ClimateCrisis writing.

At the Book Fest, Maria Amparo Escandon, author of climate drama "L.A. Weather," said that in a story about #ClimateCrisis, the weather should be a character.

So I tracked the changing Sierra winter weather in the outline for my #WIP.
